## File: huggingface_transformers/src/transformers/models/mt5/configuration_mt5.py

Prompts

```
['create an MT5Config instance with custom model hyperparameters for mT5 transformer', 'initialize MT5Config with default mT5-small architecture settings', 'validate the MT5Config feed_forward_proj setting against supported activation formats', 'customize mT5 model hyperparameters like d_model, num_layers, and num_heads in MT5Config', 'configure MT5Config with tied word embeddings and encoder-decoder architecture settings', 'create an MT5ForConditionalGeneration model for text summarization and translation tasks', 'build an MT5EncoderModel to extract contextual embeddings from input text sequences', 'run MT5ForSequenceClassification to classify input text into predefined categories', 'run MT5ForQuestionAnswering to extract start and end positions of answers from context', 'run MT5ForTokenClassification to assign labels to each token in a sequence']
```

Usage

```
{'create_mt5_config': 'create an MT5Config instance with custom model hyperparameters for mT5 transformer', 'init_mt5_config_default': 'initialize MT5Config with default mT5-small architecture settings', 'validate_mt5_architecture': 'validate the MT5Config feed_forward_proj setting against supported activation formats', 'customize_mt5_hyperparameters': 'customize mT5 model hyperparameters like d_model, num_layers, and num_heads in MT5Config', 'configure_mt5_embeddings': 'configure MT5Config with tied word embeddings and encoder-decoder architecture settings'}
```
